About Us

# Building Coimbatore's Future

Led by Sandeep Kumar (Business Head) and Sankar (Execution Head), we deliver high-quality construction with expert planning, strong execution, and complete transparency.

![Saanidhya Builders construction Coimbatore](https://saanidhyabuilders.com/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Fabout%2Fabout_us.webp&w=3840&q=75)

2+ Years of Excellence

Our Story

## Built on Trust. Delivered with Expertise.

Saanidhya Builders was founded in 2023 with a clear purpose — to bring professionalism, transparency, and quality craftsmanship to construction in Coimbatore.

Our strength lies in a well-balanced leadership structure that combines strategic business management with hands-on site execution expertise.

We don't just build structures — we build trust, value, and long-term relationships with every client we work with.

3

In Progress

Our Leadership

## Two Heads. One Vision.

Our strength lies in a well-balanced leadership structure combining strategic management with hands-on execution expertise.

![Sandeep Kumar - Business Head, Saanidhya Builders Coimbatore](https://saanidhyabuilders.com/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Fabout%2Fbusiness-head.webp&w=3840&q=75)

### Sandeep Kumar

Business & Management

Leads business operations, client acquisition, legal documentation, budgeting, and project coordination. Ensures every project is professionally managed from initiation to handover.

Responsibilities

- Client acquisition & relations
- Pricing, quotations & deal closing
- Legal documentation & agreements
- Project planning & coordination
- Branding & business growth

![Sankar - Execution Head, Saanidhya Builders Coimbatore](https://saanidhyabuilders.com/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Fabout%2Fexecution-head.webp&w=3840&q=75)

### Sankar

Construction & Engineering

Leads both management and on-site execution, ensuring projects are planned efficiently and delivered with high-quality standards. Oversees engineering teams, materials, timelines, and site operations.

Responsibilities

- Project management & planning
- Site supervision & execution
- Engineering & technical work
- Labor & material management
- Quality control & safety
- On-time project delivery

Together, we ensure every project is handled with clear planning, strong execution, and complete accountability.

### Our Mission

To deliver high-quality construction experiences built on trust, transparency, and timely completion — giving every client complete confidence from project start to handover.

### Our Vision

To become the most trusted name in construction across Coimbatore and Tamil Nadu — known for our integrity, professional approach, and the lasting quality of every structure we build.

Our Values

## What Drives Us

### Trust & Transparency

Clear communication, honest pricing, and no hidden costs — at every stage.

### Quality Workmanship

Premium materials and skilled execution with rigorous quality control on site.

### Timely Completion

Milestone-based planning and dedicated execution to deliver on time, every time.

### Client-First Approach

Your vision drives every decision — from first consultation to final handover.

## Interior Execution & Coordination

We don't claim to be interior design experts — but we make the process simple for you. We connect you with reliable interior designers and skilled contractors, and coordinate the entire execution from start to finish. Whether it's modular kitchens, wardrobes, ceilings, or complete furnishing, we ensure the work gets done smoothly without you dealing with multiple vendors.

- Access to trusted interior designers
- Execution handled by experienced contractors
- Single point of coordination
- No need to manage multiple vendors
- End-to-end interior execution support

## Building Process Overview
![Saanidhya Builders construction process](https://saanidhyabuilders.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.unsplash.com%2Fphoto-1503387762-592deb58ef4e%3Fw%3D1920%26q%3D80&w=3840&q=75)

How We Work

# Our Process

A transparent 5-step journey from your first call to moving into your dream space in Coimbatore.

01

## Consultation

We start with a deep-dive consultation to understand your vision, needs, and budget. Our experts guide you through possibilities, site constraints, and realistic cost expectations.

- Project brief document
- Preliminary budget range
- Site visit report
- Initial timeline estimate

02

## Planning

Detailed project planning including site surveys, soil testing, structural engineering, cost estimation, and regulatory compliance checks. Every detail mapped before we begin.

- Detailed BOQ (Bill of Quantities)
- Soil test report
- Structural engineering drawings
- Regulatory compliance checklist

03

## Design

Our architects create stunning 3D designs and blueprints, refined iteratively until you are 100% satisfied. We handle DTCP approvals and all permit submissions.

- 3D exterior & interior renders
- Approved floor plans
- DTCP/CMDA approval
- Material specification sheet

04

## Construction

Expert execution with premium materials, certified contractors, and real-time progress updates at every milestone. Weekly WhatsApp photo updates keep you informed from anywhere.

- Foundation & structure
- Brickwork & roofing
- Plumbing & electrical
- Finishing & painting

05

## Handover

Final quality inspection, snagging walkthrough, and post-completion support. Your dream home, delivered with complete documentation and post-handover support.

- Completion certificate
- Warranty card
- As-built drawings
- Post-handover support guide

## Our Warranty Promise

Every project comes with a comprehensive warranty package

10–15 years

Structural Warranty

1–2 years

Plumbing & Electrical

1–3 years

Waterproofing

Warranty periods vary based on materials, brands, and site conditions. Exact terms are outlined in your project contract.

## Privacy Policy Overview
# Privacy Policy

Last updated: March 11, 2026

Saanidhya Builders ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website [https://saanidhyabuilders.com](https://saanidhyabuilders.com/) or use our construction services. Please read this policy carefully. If you disagree with its terms, please discontinue use of our site.

## 1. Information We Collect

### Information you provide directly

When you contact us through our website, request a consultation, or submit an inquiry, we may collect your full name, phone number, email address, postal address or project location, details about your project, and any other information you choose to share.

### Information collected automatically

When you visit our website, we automatically collect certain technical information including your IP address, browser type and version, pages visited, time spent, referring website, and device type. This is collected through cookies and standard analytics tools.

## 2. Legal Basis for Processing

We process your personal data based on your consent (when you submit forms), contractual necessity (to provide requested services), compliance with legal obligations, and our legitimate business interests such as improving our services and website experience.

## 3. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to respond to enquiries, provide consultations, prepare quotations, communicate project updates, improve our website and services, comply with legal obligations, and ensure the security of our platform. We do not use your data for automated decision-making or profiling.

## 4. Sharing of Information

We do not sell, rent, or monetize your personal information. We may share your data only with trusted service providers (such as hosting, analytics, or email services), legal authorities when required, or in case of a business transfer. All third parties are required to maintain confidentiality and security.

## 5. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

We use cookies and similar technologies to improve user experience and analyze website traffic. This includes essential cookies, analytics cookies, and preference cookies. Third-party tools such as Google Analytics, Google Ads, or Meta Pixel may also collect anonymized data.

## 6. Data Storage and Transfer

Your data is stored securely on servers managed by trusted service providers. These servers may be located in India or other jurisdictions depending on the infrastructure used. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for data protection.

## 7. Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures including HTTPS encryption, access controls, and secure storage practices to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure.

## 8. Data Retention

We retain personal data only as long as necessary to fulfill its purpose, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. General enquiry data may be retained for up to 2 years, while client records may be retained for at least 7 years as per applicable laws.

## 9. Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data, object to certain processing, and withdraw consent at any time. Requests can be made by contacting us, and we will respond within a reasonable timeframe.

## 10. Consent

By using our website or submitting your information, you consent to the collection and use of your data as described in this Privacy Policy.

## 11. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites such as social media platforms or external services. We are not responsible for their privacy practices and encourage you to review their policies.

## 12. Children's Privacy

Our services are not intended for individuals under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If such data is identified, we will take steps to delete it.

## 13. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will be reflected with an updated 'Last Updated' date. Continued use of the website indicates acceptance of the updated policy.

## 14. Grievance Officer

For any concerns regarding your data or this policy, you may contact our Grievance Officer. Email: info@saanidhyabuilders.com. We aim to respond within 30 days as per applicable laws.

## 15. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at: info@saanidhyabuilders.com or through our website contact form.

Saanidhya Builders

## 16. Images and Media Disclaimer

Some images used on our website are sourced from third-party platforms or generated using AI tools. These images are for illustrative purposes only and may not represent actual projects, clients, or results. We ensure that all media used complies with applicable usage rights and licenses.

## 17. Content Accuracy

We strive to ensure that all information on our website is accurate and up to date. However, errors, omissions, or outdated information may occasionally occur.

We do not guarantee the completeness, reliability, or accuracy of the content. Users are advised to verify important details with us directly before making decisions based on the information provided on this website.

This Privacy Policy is governed by the laws of India. Any disputes arising from this policy shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.

Last updated: March 11, 2026

These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the [Saanidhya Builders website](https://saanidhyabuilders.com/) and the construction services we provide. By using our website or engaging our services, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and our [Privacy Policy](https://saanidhyabuilders.com/privacy).

## 1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing or using the Saanidhya Builders website (www.saanidhyabuilders.com) or engaging our construction services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our website or services.

These Terms apply to all visitors, clients, and others who access or use our website. We reserve the right to update these Terms at any time. Continued use of our website following the posting of changes constitutes your acceptance of the revised Terms.

## 2. Our Services

Saanidhya Builders provides residential construction, commercial construction, architectural design, turnkey project management, renovation and remodeling services in Coimbatore and surrounding areas of Tamil Nadu.

Information on our website about services, pricing, timelines, and specifications is provided for general guidance only and may be subject to change without prior notice. Actual project scope, cost, and timelines are determined through formal consultation, site assessment, and written agreements signed between both parties.

We reserve the right to refuse service to anyone for any reason at our sole discretion.

## 3. Quotations & Estimates

Any cost estimates, quotations, or project timelines provided through our website, via email, or during consultation are indicative only and do not constitute a binding contract.

A binding construction agreement is only formed when:
• A formal written contract is prepared and signed by both parties
• The agreed deposit or advance payment is received by Saanidhya Builders
• We issue a written confirmation of project commencement

All quotations are valid for 30 days from the date of issue unless otherwise stated in writing. Prices are subject to change based on material costs, site conditions, and scope modifications.

## 4. Payment Terms

Payment schedules are defined in the individual construction contract signed for each project. General payment terms include:

• An advance/booking amount as specified in the contract
• Stage-based progress payments linked to construction milestones
• Final payment upon project completion and handover

All payments are to be made by bank transfer, cheque, or other methods specified in the contract. GST (Goods and Services Tax) at applicable rates will be charged in addition to quoted amounts unless explicitly stated otherwise.

Late payments may attract interest at the rate of 18% per annum on the outstanding amount from the due date, as specified in the project contract.

## 5. Intellectual Property

All content on this website — including but not limited to text, graphics, logos, images, architectural drawings, design concepts, and software — is the property of Saanidhya Builders or its content suppliers and is protected under Indian copyright law.

You may not reproduce, distribute, modify, create derivative works from, publicly display, or exploit any content from this website without our prior written consent.

Architectural designs and drawings prepared by our team remain our intellectual property until full payment is received.

## 6. Acceptable Use of Website

When using our website, you agree not to:

• Use the site for any unlawful purpose
• Attempt unauthorised access
• Send harmful or spam content
• Scrape or extract data
• Impersonate others
• Disrupt website performance

We reserve the right to restrict access if these terms are violated.

## 7. Warranties & Construction Guarantee

We provide warranties as specified in project contracts. These cover defects in materials or workmanship under normal use and exclude misuse, unauthorised modifications, natural disasters, and normal wear and tear.

Exact warranty terms are defined in the project agreement.

## 8. Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by Indian law, Saanidhya Builders shall not be liable for indirect or consequential damages, inaccuracies in website content, project delays beyond our control, or website downtime.

Total liability shall not exceed the contract value unless required by law.

## 9. Force Majeure

We are not liable for delays due to events beyond control such as natural disasters, government actions, supply disruptions, or unrest. Affected timelines will be adjusted accordingly.

## 10. Dispute Resolution

Disputes will first be attempted to resolve through negotiation. If unresolved, they will be referred to arbitration under Indian law in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Courts in Coimbatore shall have jurisdiction.

## 11. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the laws of India. Legal proceedings shall be handled in Coimbatore courts.

## 12. Privacy

Your use of our website is also governed by our Privacy Policy.

## 13. Contact Information

For questions, contact us during business hours.

Construction

# Complete Guide to House Construction in Coimbatore

1 March 2026 · 3 min read · By Saanidhya Builders

[Back to Blog](https://saanidhyabuilders.com/blog)

![Saanidhya Builders](https://saanidhyabuilders.com/_next/image?url=%2Flogo%2Flogo.png&w=128&q=75)

Saanidhya Builders

Expert construction team · 1 March 2026 · 3 min read

Building your own home is one of the most important decisions you'll make. In a growing city like Coimbatore, proper planning and the right guidance can make the entire construction journey smooth and stress-free.

This guide walks you through the complete house construction process, from idea to completion.

* * *

## Understanding Your Requirements

Before starting construction, it's important to clearly define your needs. Think about the size of your home, number of rooms, future expansion, and lifestyle preferences.

A well-planned home not only improves comfort but also avoids costly changes during construction.

* * *

## Choosing the Right Plot

The quality of your construction starts with the land itself. Factors like soil condition, road access, drainage, and surrounding development play a major role.

Always verify legal documents and ensure the plot has proper approvals before proceeding.

* * *

## Planning and Design

Good design is the foundation of a successful project. Work with experienced architects to create a layout that balances aesthetics, functionality, and ventilation.

Key aspects to focus on:

- Natural lighting and airflow
- Space utilization
- Structural safety
- Future modifications

* * *

## Getting Approvals

Before construction begins, you need to obtain approvals from local authorities. This includes building plan approval, utility permissions, and compliance with local regulations.

Working with professionals helps simplify this process and avoids delays.

* * *

## Selecting Materials

Material selection directly impacts the durability and quality of your home. Choosing the right materials ensures long-term performance and lower maintenance.

Common options include:

- Modern lightweight blocks for better insulation
- Traditional bricks for proven reliability
- High-quality cement and steel for structural strength

* * *

## Hiring the Right Contractor

A reliable contractor plays a crucial role in execution. Look for experience, transparency, and past project quality when making your decision.

It's always better to:

- Check previous work
- Compare multiple options
- Ensure clear communication

* * *

## Construction Process

The construction process typically follows these stages:

1. Site preparation
2. Foundation work
3. Structural framework
4. Wall construction
5. Roofing
6. Finishing and interiors

Each stage needs proper supervision to maintain quality and timelines.

* * *

## Quality Checks and Supervision

Regular monitoring ensures that work is done correctly and materials are used as planned. Even small mistakes during construction can lead to bigger issues later.

Professional supervision helps maintain standards and avoid rework.

* * *

## Final Finishing and Handover

The final stage includes painting, fixtures, electrical work, and interior elements. This is where your house starts to feel like a home.

A proper inspection before handover ensures everything is completed as expected.

* * *

## Tips for a Smooth Construction Experience

- Plan everything before starting
- Avoid frequent design changes
- Work with experienced professionals
- Maintain clear communication
- Focus on quality over shortcuts

* * *

Building a house doesn't have to be complicated. With the right approach and guidance, you can turn your vision into reality without unnecessary stress.

> Planning to build your dream home in Coimbatore? Connect with Saanidhya Builders for expert guidance and end-to-end construction support.
